en.headline: Observatory issues Red Fire Danger Warning as risk turns extreme
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Red Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Saturday, warning of extreme fire risk amid very dry conditions.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Red Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Saturday, indicating that the fire risk is extreme. The warning remains in force until further notice.

A dry northeast monsoon is bringing fine and very dry weather to southern China. Relative humidity at the Observatory fell to around 31 per cent by 8am, with temperatures near 22 degrees Celsius. Urban areas are expected to reach about 26 degrees during the day, with even higher readings in the New Territories.

The Observatory said the public should be extra alert and ensure necessary fire precautions are taken. Yellow or Red Fire Danger Warnings are issued when weather conditions and vegetation dryness raise the chance of fires starting and spreading. Moderate north to northeasterly winds are expected, occasionally fresh offshore and up to strong on high ground.
The outlook is for mainly fine conditions in the next couple of days, with stronger winds tomorrow. The middle and latter parts of next week are expected to turn rather warm during the day.

zh.headline: 天文台發出紅色火災危險警告 火警風險極高
zh.dek: 天文台周六上午6時發出紅色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性極高，市民需提高警覺並採取防火措施。
body: 香港天文台於周六上午6時發出紅色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性極高。警告仍然生效，直至另行通知。
乾燥的東北季候風正為華南帶來晴朗及非常乾燥的天氣。天文台上午8時錄得相對濕度約31%，氣溫約22度。市區日間最高氣溫約26度，新界再高一兩度。
天文台提醒市民應特別提高警覺，並確保採取適當防火措施。黃色或紅色火災危險警告是根據有利火警發生及蔓延的天氣條件，以及草木乾燥情況而發出。預料吹和緩北至東北風，離岸風勢間中清勁，高地達強風程度。
展望未來兩三日大致天晴，明日風勢頗大。下週中後期日間相當溫暖。
